source.format: primary article JATS XML via Europe PMC

locators.mapping: Pearson correlation followed by inverse hyperbolic tangent; press/release/poke concatenated 3000-bin PETH, 1 ms bins, +/-500 ms per event.

Matched units on consecutive calendar days, mean firing rate at least 1 Hz and peak PETH firing rate at least 5 Hz. Exclude datasets below 100 valid pairs in any of DANT, UnitMatch and EMD. Per-dataset median PETH similarity; original eight retained datasets.

Friedman across methods; source R PMCMRplus, with Nemenyi post hoc when appropriate. This kernel computes the three-baseline tie-corrected omnibus statistic and asymptotic chi-square(df=2) p-value only. It does not implement Nemenyi.

predecessor.distinction: Predecessor all-pair mean and prospective all13/animal-split diagnostic is not the Figure5E filtered median. No predecessor or canonical files modified.

numerical_policy.correlation: Float64-equivalent Python float, prescaling before centering; constant vectors undefined; within eight machine epsilons of absolute correlation one snapped to signed infinity, inherited explicitly from predecessor engineering policy.
numerical_policy.median: Standard odd/even median; central opposite infinities undefined, not zero-filled.
numerical_policy.friedman: Rank within each dataset, average tied ranks, standard tie correction, three original method columns only. Undefined retained median blocks statistic; all-method ties in every dataset explicitly undefined.
numerical_policy.support: At least100 defined pairs in each original method. Optional candidate cannot change the selected dataset support.
numerical_policy.dates: Exact ISO calendar dates separated by one day; ordinal session adjacency is insufficient. Native author date-index parity remains unverified.
numerical_policy.rate: Source mean-rate metadata supplied by operator with measurement provenance; peak threshold calculated directly from PETH bins in Hz. Authentic source mean-rate preparation remains unresolved.

population_and_execution.original_figure5_population: 41591 units,12 datasets,10 rats; rats2/4 first31sessions and rat6 excluded. Exact mapping to version20019489 release not recovered by this component.
population_and_execution.peth_independence: Explicit operator assertion required; external executable provenance still needs audit and this declaration is not proof.

outcomes.reproduction: First-class outcome; this is an executable safeguard component, with no empirical reproduction score.
outcomes.improvement: First-class separate outcome; optional candidate report does not define a non-degradation threshold or establish improvement.
outcomes.paired_conditions: Same operator population/scorer intended for paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions. Participant delivery remains unbuilt here.
